messages.text: Rename this field to "Your first name" and make this input half as wide

agent.managerSummary:
The input is now half-width. The label rename has to happen in your Wix form builder — [open the form here](https://manage.wix.com/dashboard/f8f52542-3846-4a9d-8f11-2e0c40ccfa99/wix-forms/form/e87b4d6f-6a0f-4b5b-b730-63b9fa236f35) and change the label to "Your first name".
Dispatched to a new /contact lane — a worker will rename the field to "Your first name" and halve its width.

lanes.name: /contact
lanes.summary:
The width change is applied. The first-name input now has `class="half-width"` which gives it 50% width via the new CSS rule.

For the label rename: the first-name label comes from `{contact.firstNameD142.label}` — a binding that reads from the Wix Forms dashboard. Per the plugin's editing guide, labels must be renamed in the Wix form builder, not in jay-html code. Here's the direct dashboard link to edit this form:

https://manage.wix.com/dashboard/f8f52542-3846-4a9d-8f11-2e0c40ccfa99/wix-forms/form/e87b4d6f-6a0f-4b5b-b730-63b9fa236f35
